title: Kuedzwa kweChisikwa Chitsvene
intro: Chiratidzo chakatumirwa kurudzi rwakanga rwatsauka. Pakati pehupenyu hwavo hwakanaka pakauya yambiro—ichiperekedzwa nechisikwa chinoshamisa chaizova muedzo mukuru wekutenda kwavo. Mhinduro yavo yaizosimbisa mugumo wavo nekusingaperi. Ungaziva here kuti ndiani akapa yambiro iyi uye chii chakazoitika kune avo vakairamba?
clues: Taiva vanhu vakatungamirirwa nevatumwa vakapfuura isu.
Chisikwa chinoshamisa chakabuda mugomo, chiratidzo chakabva kuna Ishe wedu kurudzi urwu.
Ndakavaudza kuti: 'Iyi ingamera hadzi yaAllah, saka musiyei idye kubva muvhu raAllah uye musaibate nechinhu chakaipa.'
Asi vanhu vakagura makumbo engamera yangu, vachiramba murairo waIshe wavo.
Ndiri mutumwa kubva kuna Tenzi wako, ndakatumwa nechokwadi—ndiri muporofita nemuranda akavimbika.
Kana vari vatadzi, Ishe wedu vakavarova neruzha rukuru, uye vakamira mudzimba dzavo.

arabic: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ فَكَانُوا۟ كَهَشِيمِ ٱلْمُحْتَظِرِ
verse: Indeed, We sent upon them one shriek [i.e., blast from the sky], and they became like the dry twig fragments of an [animal] pen. (54:31)
